status: mapping example only; existing parcel frontend is unchanged

identity_mapping.id: exact entity.id or parcel.id string, including literal dots
identity_mapping.join_policy: Index entities and parcels by the complete Ref once. Reject duplicate Ref. Resolve custodian and carrierId through an explicit current-generation registry; reject ambiguity. Never split a dotted ID.

state_projection.value_rule: Euclidean norm of this exact actor's fixture velocity array
state_projection.observation_commit: frame.tick under explicit authored-fixture adapter policy
state_projection.available_after_commit: frame.tick under that same hypothetical policy
state_projection.available_ns: fixture availability timestamp; never relabel as wall-clock or measured provider receipt

require_explicit_provider_contract_befor: Valid intervals, observation stage and available-time/commit domain
Source-approved coordinate transform and quantity meaning
Transaction ID, expected custody revision, release/acquire evidence and authority fencing epoch
Complete scoped occupancy coverage for negative queries
Physical authority evidence for attachment changes; custody alone cannot prove detachment
frontend_contract: Pass a prepared immutable view frame to existing setFrame. The view owns no world clock, state authority, custody commit or command dispatch. Its authored receipt and delivered enum alone are not a ledger commit.
limits: No assertion that the sampled UI fixture has real provider evidence, a custody transaction ledger, closed-loop motion, or completed return/landing.
